## Projects

```{r}
#| results: asis

# ---- Edit/add projects here -------------------------------------------------
projects <- list(
  list(
    title = "EXAMPLE",
    description = paste(
      "EXAMPLE",
      "EXAMPLE"
    ),
    tags = c("R", "tidyr", "PostgreSQL"),
    url  = "https://github.com/EllieWilser"
  )
)

# ---- Render each project as a Bootstrap card --------------------------------
cat("::: {.row .row-cols-1 .row-cols-md-3 .g-4}\n\n")
for (p in projects) {
  cat("::: {.col}\n::: {.card .h-100}\n::: {.card-body}\n\n")
  cat("### ", p$title, " {.mt-0}\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(p$description, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(paste0("[", p$tags, "]{.badge .text-bg-secondary}", collapse = " "), "\n\n")
  cat("[View project](", p$url, "){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(":::\n:::\n:::\n\n")
}
cat(":::\n")
```
